name: Smash N Wings
tagline: Takeaway ordering app · collection & delivery · Bedford
description: Ordering app for Smash N Wings in Bedford: smash burgers and wings for collection or delivery, with deals, stamp rewards and a weekly spin-to-win.
tips: Customers choose collection or delivery, then order in a couple of taps from the full menu with photos.
Deals sit at the top of the home screen, so offers get seen straight away.
Every order earns a stamp: a free mojito or milkshake upgrade at 4, and a free portion of wings at 8.
Spin to win every Friday. Prizes go straight into the basket and must be used within 24 hours.
Orders go to a tablet in the shop and print on a Bluetooth printer, with no commission to delivery apps.

name: Mikael Café
description: Order-ahead café app with new item alerts, a stamp card, spin-to-win rewards and a QR membership code.
tips: Your customers land on a home screen with your newest item front and centre, ready to add to the basket in one tap.
They order ahead for collection, so the order is waiting when they arrive.
A digital stamp card fills up with every order and gives a free treat at the end, so regulars come back.
Spin & Win gives customers a reason to open the app again, with prizes you control.
Find us shows your address, opening times and directions, and the QR button opens their membership code.

name: Allure Club
description: Members club app with QR membership card, rewards and menu, plus the staff terminal and owner dashboard that run behind it.
tips: This is a members club: each customer gets a QR membership card on their phone instead of a paper card.
Stamps and rewards build up automatically every visit, and birthday treats can be sent out.
Tap the Staff terminal tab at the top: staff scan the customer's QR and add stamps in seconds.
The Admin dashboard tab is the owner's side: members, rewards, offers and push notifications in one place.
Push notifications let you send an offer to every member's phone without paying for ads.

name: Flava Box
description: Build-your-box ordering with pre-orders, a rewards club, spin-to-win and direct WhatsApp checkout. No commission on orders.
tips: Customers build their own box step by step, which keeps ordering quick and stops mistakes.
When the shop is closed they can still pre-order for later, so you don't lose the sale.
Deals and a rewards club sit inside the app, with stamps and spin-to-win to bring people back.
Orders go straight to you with no commission taken by a delivery platform.
Order again puts a customer's last order back in the basket in one tap.

name: Crave Corner
tagline: Dessert ordering app · collection & eat in
description: Dessert café app with collection or eat-in ordering, a digital stamp card and rewards.
tips: Customers choose collection or eat in before they order, so the kitchen knows what's coming.
The full menu has photos and prices, and items go to the basket in one tap.
A stamp card fills up with each order, with spin-to-win prizes on top.
Reviews and directions are built in, so new customers can find you and trust you.

name: Café Grill
tagline: Café ordering & rewards · Leagrave Road, Luton
description: Order-ahead app for Café Grill in Luton: all-day breakfast, brunch, grill and Cakes Danieli desserts, for collection or eat in, with a stamp card.
tips: Customers order ahead for collection or eat in, and skip the queue.
Eating in? They order from the table and the food is brought over.
The Find us box shows if the café is open now and when it next opens, so customers never turn up to a closed door.
The full menu has photos: all-day breakfast, benedicts, the grill, wings and burgers.
Cakes Danieli has its own section, with cake slices and dessert pots, to sell more desserts.
Every order earns a stamp: a free hot drink at 4 and a free burger meal at 8.
Google reviews and directions are built in, so new customers trust you and find you.
Delivery buttons go straight to your Uber Eats and Deliveroo pages.
On a laptop it opens as a full website with the same menu, so customers can order for collection from any screen.

name: Chunk
tagline: Stuffed cookie shop app · Luton & Rotherham
description: Customer ordering for two locations, with photos, allergen info, offers and delivery or collection.
tips: Customers pick a location first, so each shop gets its own orders.
Every cookie has its photo, price and allergen info.
Offers and push notifications can be sent to customers' phones.
Customers choose delivery or collection, and the order comes straight to the shop with no platform fees.
New: gift cards. Customers buy one for a friend: emailed, collected as a printed card, or delivered in a gift box.
New: gift wrap a full box. The lid closes, then a ribbon, bow and handwritten tag go on, for an extra £2.

name: Kaya Lounge
tagline: Shisha lounge, food & live sport · Luton
description: Venue app with the full menu, live sport fixtures on the big screens and directions.
tips: The full menu sits in the app, so customers can browse before they arrive.
Sports shows which games are on the big screens this week, a big reason for people to visit.
Customers can leave reviews and get directions straight from the app.
No app store needed: customers open it from a link or a QR code on the table.

name: Gold Wash
description: Prices for every service, the Gold Club stamp card (every 8th wash free) and directions.
tips: Prices for every wash and valet are clear, so customers know what to expect before they arrive.
The Gold Club stamp card gives every 8th wash free, so customers keep coming back to you.
Referrals reward customers for bringing a friend.
A gallery and reviews show the quality of the work.

name: Valor Barbers App
tagline: Customer & staff app · Eaton Green, Luton
description: Branded barbershop app: booking, Valor Club loyalty card, shop, waitlist and push offers, plus a staff app for the barbers and owner.
tips: Customers join Valor Club free. Their card collects a stamp every cut and the 10th cut is free.
Booking takes seconds: pick a barber who's online, a service and a time. Full? Join the waitlist and get pinged when a slot opens.
After each visit customers rate the cut. Happy customers are sent straight to leave a Google review.
Staff app (Me tab → staff link): barbers accept bookings, block out time, go offline and keep private client notes like 'no razor on the neck'.
The owner sends push offers to everyone or only people who haven't been in for a month, and sees revenue, regulars and feedback reports.
No app store or commission: customers add it to their home screen from a link or QR code.

name: Forkys Desserts
description: Dessert shop app for Forkys in Luton: order ahead for collection or delivery, collect stamps and win rewards.
tips: Customers pick collection or delivery first, then order ahead and skip the queue.
Signature desserts like the Bruce Cake and Matilda Cake sit front and centre, with real photos.
The cookie drop is a swipeable carousel. Tap any cookie to see it up close.
Can't decide? Spin the fork and the app picks a dessert for them.
Every order adds a stamp: free custard at 4 and a free Matilda Cake at 8, which keeps customers coming back.

name: Chocco's Luton
tagline: Dessert parlour app · collection, eat in & delivery
description: Ordering and rewards app for Chocco's Dessert Parlour in Luton: collection, eat in at the table, or delivery.
tips: Customers choose collection, eat in or delivery before they order.
Eating in? They add their table number and order without queuing at the counter.
Waffles, crêpes, cakes and shakes are laid out with photos, and go to the basket in one tap.
Every order earns a stamp: a free topping upgrade at 4 and a free dessert at 8.
Opening times, directions and a call button are on the Visit tab.

name: Flamez Luton
tagline: Smash burgers & Nashville chicken · ordering app · Luton
description: Ordering app for Flamez in Luton: smash burgers, Nashville hot chicken, wings, tenders and Munch Boxes, for collection or delivery, with Flamez Club rewards.
tips: Customers order direct for collection or delivery and pay online, with no commission to delivery apps.
Today's deals are one tap away from the home screen.
Flamez Club: a stamp on every order, so regulars keep coming back.
Spin and win: a weekly chance at prizes like a free Munch Box.
Delivery tracking shows customers where their order is.
Customers rate their order, and the shop admin sees every bit of feedback.
